---
title: "E305: Nondeterminism in a deterministic model"
description: "Two edges from the same state can apply in the same configuration."
---

<!-- Generated by `deltac gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

Two edges from the same state can apply in the same configuration.

## Example

```delta error
dfa M (partial) {
  start q0
  accept q1
  q0 -a-> q0
  q0 -a-> q1
}
```
